antipodes-parakeet.review: Island inserted in the vernacular name; description locates the bird at Ringdove Bay, Antipodes Island. Exact article P225 is Cyanoramphus unicolor.

arctic-skua.review: Arctic skua is the catalogue vernacular for Stercorarius parasiticus, called parasitic jaeger by the exact article; Commons names Arctic skua.

auckland-rail.review: Replace the Wikipedia lead illustration with a photograph explicitly identified as Lewinia muelleri on Adams Island.

auckland-teal.file: File:Auckland Island teal on Enderby Island.jpg
auckland-teal.review: Vernacular includes Island; Commons description places the Auckland teal on Enderby Island. Article P225 confirms Anas aucklandica.

black-browed-albatross.review: Filename uses the older melanophrys spelling; description explicitly identifies Black-browed Albatross, whose article taxon is Thalassarche melanophris.

black-petrel.review: Joined vernacular filename; Commons description explicitly gives Procellaria parkinsoni.

black-winged-petrel.review: Abbreviated filename; Commons description explicitly gives Pterodroma nigripennis and Black-winged Petrel.

brown-quail.review: Older Coturnix genus in filename; Commons identifies Brown quail, exact article P225 Synoicus ypsilophorus.

buff-banded-rail.review: Gallirallus philippensis in the article and Hypotaenidia philippensis in the catalogue are genus combinations for buff-banded rail; description explicitly names it, not another rail.

campbell-albatross.review: Mollymawk vernacular in filename; Commons description explicitly identifies Campbell Albatross, with exact article P225 Thalassarche impavida.

campbell-teal.file: File:Campbell Island teal standing on the ground.jpg
campbell-teal.review: Replace an authorless lead with an attributed live-bird photograph; description names Campbell Island teal and Commons category is Anas nesiotis (captive Kiwi Park bird).

cattle-egret.file: File:Eastern Cattle-Egret in Bhagalpur December 2025 by Tisha Mukherjee 01.jpg
cattle-egret.review: Catalogue corrected from Ardea ibis to Eastern cattle egret Ardea coromanda without changing the cattle-egret ID or backup schema. Commons explicitly identifies this file as Ardea coromanda in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India, photographed on 21 December 2025 by Tisha Mukherjee (own work, CC BY-SA 4.0). Exact article P225 is Ardea coromanda. NZBO uses the older Bubulcus ibis coromandus treatment for the eastern form occurring in Australia and New Zealand. Thumbnail inspected for composition: a single live bird on grass, no livestock; reject the goat-dominated Wikipedia lead. Taxonomic identity relies on the file-specific description and locality, not an independent visual identification or a claim that the photograph was taken in NZ.

chatham-parakeet.review: Forbes vernacular misspelled in filename; description explicitly identifies Chatham Islands Parakeet on Mangere Island, matching article P225 Cyanoramphus forbesi. No assertion that hybrids have been visually excluded.

chatham-shag.review: Camera filename; description explicitly gives Leucocarbo onslowi at Manukau Point, Chatham Island.

chukar.review: German filename; Commons description explicitly gives Alectoris chukar, captive at Walsrode.

common-diving-petrel.review: Replace museum specimen/authorless lead with attributed photograph whose filename and description give Pelecanoides urinatrix.

common-myna.review: Number touches binomial in filename; Commons description explicitly gives Acridotheres tristis.

coot.review: Broader article and French lead rejected. This file documents a bird in Tasmania; NZBO identifies the Australian/New Zealand population as Fulica atra australis. Locality is necessary evidence, not the generic title alone.

eastern-rockhopper-penguin.file: File:Eastern Rockhopper Penguin, Musgrave Inlet, Auckland Island, Auckland Islands, Southland, New Zealand imported from iNaturalist photo 500379206 (cropped).jpg
eastern-rockhopper-penguin.review: Article first sentence uses Eudyptes filholi while Wikidata retains Eudyptes chrysocome filholi. File explicitly identifies eastern rockhopper at Musgrave Inlet, Auckland Island.

fairy-tern.file: File:DOC Fairy Tern photos 06 (cropped for speciesbox).jpg
fairy-tern.review: Generic filename qualified by DOC photograph description at Pakiri, near Warkworth, January 2009, in the NZ breeding population; exact article taxon is Sternula nereis davisae. Not an Australian fairy tern.

fiordland-crested-penguin.review: Vernacular includes Crested; description places this Fiordland penguin at Munro Beach. Exact article P225 is Eudyptes pachyrhynchus.

foveaux-shag.review: Broader Stewart Island shag redirect rejected. Commons categorises this specific file as Leucocarbo stewarti; original photographer explicitly locates the three birds in Foveaux Straits off Stewart Island on 23 January 2010. NZBO confirms this is the Foveaux population, unlike the Taiaroa lead.

great-spotted-kiwi.file: File:Chris Goulding from DOC holding a great spotted kiwi during a release in Kahurangi National Park.jpg
great-spotted-kiwi.review: Replace historical illustration with DOC live-bird release photograph at Kahurangi. Article first sentence uses Apteryx maxima; Wikidata/Commons retain Apteryx haastii for the same great spotted kiwi.

grey-noddy.review: Catalogue albivittus spelling differs from article/Commons albivitta; grey ternlet is the article's alternative common name. Description identifies Anous albivitta at Mokohinau Islands.

grey-tailed-tattler.review: Number touches binomial in filename; Commons description explicitly gives Tringa brevipes.

indian-peafowl.file: File:Indian Peacock in Tholpetty Wildlife Sanctuary 01.JPG
indian-peafowl.review: Replace generic peacock lead lacking taxon evidence with file whose description explicitly identifies Pavo cristatus at Tholpetty.

kakapo.review: Sirocco is explicitly identified as kakapo by Commons. Article first sentence uses catalogue Strigops habroptilus; Wikidata uses gender variant habroptila.

karearea.review: NZ abbreviation and Maori name in filename; Commons description explicitly identifies male New Zealand Falcon at Zealandia.

korora.review: Little penguin redirect and Tasmanian lead rejected. This specific file identifies white-flippered penguin (Eudyptula albosignata) at Pohatu, Banks Peninsula; Commons category Eudyptula minor albosignata matches the catalogue subspecies.

kotare.file: File:Sacred kingfisher at Point Peron, Rockingham Lakes Regional Park 01.jpg
kotare.review: Replace GFDL-only lead with CC BY-SA photograph explicitly identified as Sacred kingfisher in title and description; article P225 Todiramphus sanctus.

kotuku.review: Maori filename; Commons description explicitly gives Ardea alba modesta, breeding plumage at Hokitika.

light-mantled-albatross.file: File:Light-mantled Sooty Albatross. Auckland. Oscar Thomas.jpg
light-mantled-albatross.review: Older sooty vernacular in filename; description explicitly gives Phoebetria palpebrata offshore Auckland Island.

little-owl.file: File:Домовый сыч. Сова в каньоне урочища Бозжыра. 01.jpg
little-owl.review: Cyrillic filename; Commons English description explicitly identifies Athene noctua in Kazakhstan.

little-shearwater.review: Replace historical elegans illustration with photograph explicitly identified as Puffinus assimilis haurakiensis in New Zealand.

little-spotted-kiwi.review: Camera filename; description explicitly identifies Apteryx owenii at Zealandia, Wellington.

little-stint.review: French filename; Commons description explicitly identifies Calidris minuta.

little-tern.review: Ukrainian filename; English Commons description explicitly identifies Little Tern on Sluch River, matching exact article P225 Sternula albifrons.

magenta-petrel.review: Maori filename; description explicitly gives Pterodroma magentae, a chick held by a DOC worker on Chatham Island. Depicts a chick, not adult field plumage.

magpie.review: Older Cracticus genus in filename; description explicitly identifies Australian Magpie, matching article P225 Gymnorhina tibicen.

marsh-crake.file: File:Porzana pusilla - Mount Annan Botanical Garden.jpg
marsh-crake.review: Older Porzana genus in filename; description explicitly identifies Baillon's Crake, matching article P225 Zapornia pusilla.

matuku.review: Replace historical Buller plate with photograph explicitly identified as Botaurus poiciloptilus in filename and description.

miromiro.review: Toitoi vernacular in filename; description explicitly identifies Petroica macrocephala near Rotorua.

mute-swan.review: French filename; Commons description explicitly identifies Cygnus olor.

new-zealand-dabchick.review: Replace generic dab chick title with photograph explicitly identified as Poliocephalus rufopectus in filename and description.

new-zealand-dotterel.review: Article first sentence explicitly equates Anarhynchus obscurus and Charadrius obscurus; file identifies the latter at Hot Water Beach, Coromandel.

north-island-brown-kiwi.file: File:Apteryx mantelli -Rotorua, North Island, New Zealand-8a.jpg
north-island-brown-kiwi.review: Explicitly named North Island Brown Kiwi at Rainbow Springs, Rotorua. Replaces lead placed in an illustrations category to avoid relying on a category exception.

north-island-kokako.review: Generic kokako title; description explicitly gives North Island Kokako Callaeas wilsoni at Mount Bruce, not the South Island species.

otago-shag.review: Broader Stewart Island shag article requires locality review. This specific file documents the nesting colony at Taiaroa Head, Otago Peninsula, matching Otago shag and not Foveaux shag. The broad article name alone is not evidence.

pectoral-sandpiper.review: Number touches vernacular in filename; description explicitly identifies Pectoral Sandpiper, matching exact article P225 Calidris melanotos.

pihoihoi.review: Explicit NZ pipit override: Commons description gives Anthus novaeseelandiae novaeseelandiae on Kapiti Island. No Australian/Australasian pipit lead is accepted.

pipiwharauroa.review: Article explicitly states Chalcites lucidus was formerly in Chrysococcyx; description names Shining Bronze Cuckoo in NSW. Species-level image, not a claim about the NZ subspecies.

pohowera.review: Old genus Charadrius for the double-banded plover; article first sentence gives Anarhynchus bicinctus. File description names double-banded plover in breeding plumage at Ralphs Bay.

pomarine-skua.review: Camera suffix touches binomial; Commons description explicitly identifies Stercorarius pomarinus.

providence-petrel.review: Replace vague Mount Gower lead with file explicitly identifying Providence Petrels at their Lord Howe Island breeding location, matching article P225 Pterodroma solandri.

putangitangi.file: File:A pair of paradise shelducks, Lake Victoria, Christchurch.jpg
putangitangi.review: Plural vernacular explains failed literal match; description identifies male and female paradise shelducks at Lake Victoria, Christchurch. Exact article taxon Tadorna variegata.

puteketeke.review: Broader article reviewed: Commons documents Lake Dulverton, Tasmania. NZBO identifies the Australian and NZ population as subspecies australis. Not a European nominate bird.

red-tailed-tropicbird.review: Reject previous lead's contradictory red-billed description. Replacement description explicitly identifies Red-tailed Tropicbird at Midway; Commons category Phaethon rubricauda in flight.

redpoll.review: Old genus Carduelis in file; Commons identifies Common Redpoll. Redirected Redpoll article first sentence explicitly gives Acanthis flammea despite its genus-level Wikidata item.

reischeks-parakeet.review: Replace authorless museum specimen with photograph of three Reischek's parakeets in the Antipodes Islands, explicitly identified in title and description.

riroriro.file: File:Grey Gerygone - Pureora Forest Park, New Zealand.jpg
riroriro.review: Article introduction explicitly names grey gerygone as a synonym of grey warbler, Gerygone igata. File title locates it at Pureora, NZ.

rock-wren.review: NZ abbreviation in title; Commons description explicitly identifies Xenicus gilviventris.

royal-spoonbill.file: File:Kōtuku Ngutupapa (Royal Spoonbill) at the mouth of the Oruarangi Creek.jpg
royal-spoonbill.review: Replace GFDL-only lead with CC BY photograph explicitly identified as Platalea regia at Oruarangi Creek, Auckland.

ruff.review: Old Philomachus genus in filename; description identifies two male Ruff, matching article P225 Calidris pugnax. Captive birds.

shore-plover.review: File title explicitly names NZ Shore plover; article first sentence uses Thinornis novaeseelandiae while Wikidata has Charadrius novaeseelandiae. Description is empty, so evidence is explicitly filename only.

siberian-sand-plover.review: Reject pre-split lesser sand plover lead whose old name can include Tibetan birds. Replacement is explicitly identified as Siberian sand plover and categorised Anarhynchus mongolus; article first sentence confirms the split. Metadata review, not independent visual identification.

skylark.review: Filename omits Eurasian; Commons description explicitly gives Alauda arvensis in Cumbria.

southern-giant-petrel.review: Joined vernacular filename; description explicitly identifies Southern Giant Petrel off Isla Marta, matching article P225 Macronectes giganteus.

spotless-crake.review: Old Porzana genus in filename; description explicitly identifies Spotless Crake, matching article P225 Zapornia tabuensis.

spur-winged-plover.review: Broader article's Darwin Vanellus miles miles lead rejected. Replacement filename and description explicitly identify Vanellus miles novaehollandiae in Tasmania, matching the NZ subspecies.

subantarctic-snipe.review: Subspecies common name in filename; description explicitly identifies Coenocorypha aucklandica perseverance on Campbell Island. It is within this catalogue's species-level entry.

takahe.review: South Island takahe redirects to Takahe with exact P225 Porphyrio hochstetteri; file identifies a live male takahe rather than extinct North Island moho.

takapu.review: Replace generic gannet title with file whose filename and description explicitly identify Morus serrator.

taranui.review: Old Sterna genus in filename; description explicitly identifies Caspian Tern, matching article P225 Hydroprogne caspia.

tauhou.review: Replace GFDL-only lead with CC BY-SA photograph explicitly identifying Zosterops lateralis in description.

tete.review: Joined vernacular filename; description identifies a pair of Grey Teal in Nelson, matching exact article P225 Anas gracilis.

thin-billed-prion.review: Thin-billed prion redirects to Slender-billed prion with exact P225 Pachyptila belcheri; filename and description use slender-billed.

titi.file: File:Puffinus griseus in flight - SE Tasmania.jpg
titi.review: Old Puffinus genus in filename; description explicitly identifies Sooty Shearwater, matching article P225 Ardenna grisea.

tokoeka.review: Maori name in filename; description explicitly gives Apteryx australis and wild bird on Stewart Island.

wandering-tattler.review: Joined vernacular filename; description explicitly identifies Wandering Tattler, matching article P225 Tringa incana.

wedge-tailed-shearwater.review: Replace plant-titled lead with a flight photograph explicitly identified as Wedge-tailed Shearwater. Description uses old genus Puffinus pacificus; article P225 is Ardenna pacifica.

westland-petrel.review: Number touches binomial in filename; description explicitly identifies Procellaria westlandica off Kaikoura.

white-capped-albatross.review: Former subspecies combination in filename; description explicitly identifies White-capped albatross, matching article P225 Thalassarche steadi. Not generic shy albatross.

white-faced-heron.review: Replace GFDL-only lead with CC BY-SA photograph explicitly identified as Egretta novaehollandiae in filename and description.

yellow-crowned-parakeet.review: Generic kakariki title; description explicitly identifies a captive Yellow-crowned Parakeet, matching article P225 Cyanoramphus auriceps.
